arguments.sql: select j.JRNL_NO, sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" j join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO" group by j."JRNL_NO" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", c."ACTV_FLG" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'

select j."JRNL_NO", j."PRD_ID", j."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD", j."SRC_CD", j."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" j left join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=j."PRD_ID" where p."PRD_ID" is null or j."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and (p."CLOSE_DT" is null or j."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"))
